Unlike other grenades, it is reusable (requiring recharging between uses) and does not damage the thrower.

The quill ammo has a homing effect, causing its trajectory to curve towards the center-of-mass of the target nearest the crosshairs. This homing effect is reasonable, but has limits, and also tends to make shots on weakpoints more difficult to land. The quills deal 35 sharp damage on impact, and has a chance to apply an acid burn to the target, dealing acid damage over time. The Seeker Quill ammo can often be retrieved after firing, both from surface

summary: It has a basic stab attack, and a secondary attack. When the primary attack button is pressed, the spear will stab similar to other spears. The weapon can be loaded with up to 15 Seeker Quills and fired with the alt-fire button, shooting up to 5 quills in a forward cone per shot. Each quill does 30 Sharp damage.

name: Skink (Weapon)
description: A deadly biological cannon, with a very affable demeanour.
summary: is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It fires globs of Radioactive Waste, which are capable of sticking to walls. The trigger can be pulled rapidly for smaller globs and held for larger globs.

name: Sledgehammer
description: An exceptionally heavy hammer for pounding things into the ground.
summary: === Manufacturing West === * In the mines area, close to a truck. * In The Train, in a train car with a power socket. * In the area where the Synchrotron is, close to the exit to the Manufacturing Sector. * In the area where the Synchrotron is, inside a container.

name: Slushie Bomb
description: Once an ice cold drink, now turned into an ice bomb of sorts. Can really put a chill on any encounter.
summary: Upon landing, the will apply the Frosted debuff to anything in its explosion radius, freezing them in place for five seconds. Players and Composers are simply slowed instead. It does not cause any damage, but it can be used to escape certain encounters or land more hits on the enemy. Symphonists, Mountaineers, Close-Quarters Combatants, Rooks, and the Yeti are fully immune to the effects of s.

name: Snowball
description: Your typical ball of packed ice and snow.
flavor: Send it flying through the air with a hefty throw!
summary: The functions like a regular thrown weapon. Primary action quickly throws it, while secondary action aims your throw.

name: Snowfall Shotgun
description: A heavy shotgun, cryogenically refitted to fire ricocheting rounds that freeze enemies.
flavor: Dr. Stern doesn't often dabble in weaponry, but when he does, he always wraps it in a warm scarf of poetry. This concerns Dr. Ross.

name: Stun Baton
description: An electrified baton that briefly immobilizes enemies.
flavor: Safety suggestion: Hold the boring end.
summary: is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It can stun enemies with electricity, temporarily preventing them from moving or attacking.

name: Sword
description: An edged, bladed weapon intended for cutting
summary: === Furniture Store === * Mounted on the wall over the fireplace on the first floor.

name: Talagi Magnum
description: A high-powered handcannon capable of neutralizing large foes and completely obliterating smaller ones.
flavor: A few shots from this should put down most things on Earth. However...
summary: requires the player character to have the Bio-Metric Armwraps (Buff), the Bio-Mimic Armwraps (Buff), or Bio-Fusion Armwraps (Buff). The recipe for the Armwraps is unlocked upon reaching Accuracy level 7.

name: Tech Sceptre
description: An electrically charged mace. Requires a charge to deal electrical damage and knock back enemies.
summary: uses battery charge to cause extra shock damage on hit. It can still be used even if it is out of charge but will not cause the extra shock damage.

name: Thermal Mallet
description: A sturdy hammer capable of leaving scorching fire at the location it hits.
summary: uses battery charge to create a flame where it hits, causing fire damage to anything inside the flame's area (including player characters). It can still be used even without battery, but won't cause the flame effect.

name: Thermite Molotov
description: An explosive charge made from alien residue.
flavor: This will burn through just about anything.
summary: Upon landing, the creates an area of flames for 10 seconds that deals 10 fire damage per second to anything inside its range.

name: Thresher
description: A heavy-hitting carbon alloy blade launcher with a twin-tier accelerator.
summary: is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It fires Grinder Discs that are capable of bouncing off walls.

name: Throw Net
description: A throwable net, great for temporarily trapping small creatures, leaving them vulnerable. This net might even confuse a larger creature for a short while.
summary: is a throwable weapon in Abiotic Factor. It disables small and medium enemies for a few seconds. Pests, when captured by a net, can be instantly killed with a stomp. Doing so will always make the Pest drop one Bio Scrap.

name: Throwing Crystal
description: A pellucid blade made from the knapped crystal remains of IS-0139, fragile but expertly balanced for throwing.
summary: functions like a regular thrown weapon. Its primary attack is a basic stab that spends one projectile on each attack. Its secondary action prepares to throw it. Can be used to harvest remains.

name: Throwing Dart
description: A simple, throwable blade, but unlikely to survive the journey.
summary: functions like a regular thrown weapon. Its primary attack is a basic stab that spends one projectile on each attack. Its secondary action prepares to throw it. Can be used to harvest remains.

name: Throwing Quill
description: A throwable, acidic quill derived from IS-0184 and its kin. Not particularly durable, but particularly deadly.
summary: functions like a regular thrown weapon. Its primary attack is a basic stab that spends one projectile on each attack. Its secondary action prepares to throw it. Can be used to harvest remains, though at the worst chopping quality (and thus highest chance for turning the corpse into Bio Scrap). When thrown, also applies an Acid Burn on impact, dealing an additional 30 Acid damage over 1.5 seconds.

name: Throwing Shard
description: A lethally sharp and strong blade of super-hardened ice.
summary: functions like a regular thrown weapon. Its primary attack is a basic stab that spends one projectile on each attack. Its secondary action prepares to throw it. Can be used to harvest remains.

description: A hefty shotgun that launches acidic, ricocheting rounds, with biometric locks removed.

name: Toilet Plunger
description: It sort of speaks for itself.

name: Umbrella
description: Portable protection from rain or sun

name: Verdant Skink (Weapon)
description: Flings skink mucus to apply medical aid to allies from afar. Charged shots create larger healing clouds.
flavor: Turn deadly green slime into healthful green slime!
summary: is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It fires globs of healing Radioactive Waste that explode into healing spores on contact with any surface. The trigger can be pulled rapidly for smaller globs and held for larger globs.

name: Verenkov's SMG
description: A heavily retooled SMG that ionizes projectiles for greater damage against bodyshields, with biometric locks removed.
flavor: Dr. Verenkov's experimental 'plasmification' technology was originally intended for rapid ignition of fuel pellets.
summary: is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It deals Plasma damage that is especially effective against Hardlight shields.

name: Volt Staff
description: An augmented Exor staff that condenses and discharges bioelectric energy. Charges by striking foes.
flavor: Transmutes life energy into an electrical death force.
summary: is a weapon in Abiotic Factor. It has a basic stab attack, and a secondary attack. When the left mouse button is pressed, the spear will stab similar to other spears. The weapon can be charged by stabbing enemies and fired with the right mouse button, firing a blast of energy.

name: Weapons and Ammo
summary: Weapons and Ammo is a crafting category of items in Abiotic Factor. Items in this category can be used to damage enemies or other players.

name: Welding Spear
description: A superheated spear capable of dealing explosive fire damage to targets.
summary: uses battery charge to cause a small explosion in the area around where it hits, damaging enemies and furniture around it. It can still be used even without battery, but won't cause the explosion effect.

name: Wessex Rifle
description: A high-powered, bolt-action, military-grade sniper rifle.
summary: requires the player to have Accuracy level 7 and the Bio-Mimic Armwraps (Buff) or Bio-Fusion Armwraps (Buff) to use. The recipe for Bio-Mimic Armwraps is unlocked upon reaching Accuracy level 15.

name: Woodsman's Axe
description: A hefty axe for felling the strongest trees. Or foes.
flavor: There's a small hint of blood residue or perhaps it's simply sap. It's become difficult to tell.

name: Z-17
description: An exceptionally well-engineered and balanced semi-automatic sidearm with integrated suppressor, weighted for high velocity and low recoil.
flavor: The Z-17's design is intimately informed by ballistic lessons learned in the GATE Kinetics Division, and honors Dr. Halen Zizek, a projectile expert and Division founder whose lucky number was 17.
